list: the official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Everything is single-player: there is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so one playthrough is enough. The long pole is A Long Road, the 100% completion trophy — most of the roughly 200 hours go there, not into the story.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the story, so this trophy unlocks while you are still learning the game, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so keep playing past the chapter's last mission and it will arrive on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It unlocks as Chapter 3 opens, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. Like every chapter trophy, it comes from playing the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so the pop can lag a little behind the chapter itself — just keep playing.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx ties the pop to the chapter's last main mission, Starting From Zero. It is a story trophy, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's last mission. One disagreement to know about: PowerPyx's own table puts the final mission in Chapter 4 in one place and lists Operation Savage Glory as a Chapter 5 mission in another, while Insider Gaming lists the final mission under Chapter 5. Whichever chapter it sits in, it pops when the credits roll, and free roam carries on after it, so nothing is locked out.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run to the end. It is a story mission, so the trophy unlocks during normal play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist to the end. A story trophy: it pops as part of the mission, with nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play to the end. It unlocks during the mission, like the other named-mission story trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners to the end. A story trophy that pops during the mission itself.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown to the end. It unlocks during the mission, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. GTABase places this mission in Chapter 5, which is the other half of the disagreement about where the story's final missions sit (see You Gotta Know When to Get Off).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist after the story at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. The list is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion — and it asks for everything only in a few places: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every shooting range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. The rest is a share: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans and 15 of 18 card sets. This is the hardest trophy and the bulk of the 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy. Track them under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink a basket), playing an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. Check what is left under Progress, Activities. Most of them happen on their own while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The golds are not too hard, and range time also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger later. There is no mission replay to worry about — ranges stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for this trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location properly while you are there instead of coming back.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count — it has to be 20 distinct ones. Any mix of race types works.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Some time after that he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there, play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, or Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You only need to reach the end of one game — beating every challenge inside it is not required. The home games are available from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when he calls her and texts his home address in Belville. Play all 5 of his quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy, and every quest stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chest icons on the map: dive at 7 shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure off the ocean floor and bring it back to him. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2 to 3 — as Jason you can hurry it along by calling Brian. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Play his 5 jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. The last one awards the trophy, and all five stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying Stranger mission strands. Only some questlines count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. The questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Every stranger strand stays available after the story in free roam, and your progress shows on the trophy tracker. More qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the counter in your trophy list as you go.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on his list, then drive it back — good condition pays more. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and he marks new cars for you as you deliver them. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show synthetic labs around Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives you his last job, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which awards the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her, talk to her there and choose Accept. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1. It raises your progress counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy actually needs it — PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer all say the same thing: do it anyway, and make a manual save first. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do that first quest and he starts marking hunting spots with purple icons on the map: hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him as Jason. A clean one-shot kill with the hunting rifle he gives you (Killtelligence SM-69) pays more, but it is not required. Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx and GTABase both say so — and the 100% checklist needs all 15 of his Target Decks anyway, so work through them all and it will come.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. You do not need all of them — pick the three whose cards you find first. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. For the 100% checklist you need 15 full sets, so this trophy falls out of that work.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1, while looking at a scannable object. Any 100 count, drawn from 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in the world, so scan whatever you pass. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. You can see them under Progress, Challenges, with a tick marking the finished ones. Most of them complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy arrives on the way — leave it for late, then pick the easiest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This opens once Jason and Lucia can free-roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape until you are out of the red heat zone — the trophy pops when you leave the heat, not when you leave the flashing search area. A good escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also comes naturally during bank vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while you stay wanted — keep the flashing red and blue wanted level the whole time, never the red heat level. Bring body armor, sticky bombs and healing items, and loot properly in each shop (break the safe with sticky bombs if there is one). The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, sit close together and work well. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not come, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan). You do not need to drive them — scanning is enough. Stand beside a busy road and scan the traffic going past. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this trophy comes early on that road. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus starts with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak spots light up, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Fill it first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline to make it last longer — then line up 5 enemies and drop them without missing. Gang operation thugs work well; it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. An assault rifle like the Duke 556 is the best tool, and body armor lets you step out of cover to get close. Focus has 4 levels (check it under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Focus); it rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at gates E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs and the door by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the strip and take off. You have to fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it pops, and the pop is a little delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand at the south end of the base — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in and shoot enemies from inside until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Go in through a store's back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, empty the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which walks you through the first one: tail a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it. The haul is too heavy for one person, so bring your partner and hand off a bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first) and he marks vans with a purple icon. Any 5 of the 8 vaults is enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Every vault robbery gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles to shake the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this one (see Maximum Withdrawal) as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs. The trophy only pops after you have escaped the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every dark patch until the entire map is visible. It is pure exploration, so it comes naturally if you travel everywhere for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, Gangs — it shows how many of each gang's operations you have robbed. There are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy arrives on that road.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar with the view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx gives the bar and the drink; GTABase lists the exact steps as not confirmed yet, so if the pop does not come, try a different spot at the bar rail before moving on.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only that blue Banshee counts — it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III — and the pop is slightly delayed, coming after you drive further down the street. GTABase lists the exact steps as not confirmed yet, so treat the car and the window as the whole method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it is a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling — and take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You do not need all three in one visit: the robbery icon comes back after a long time, so you can return for whatever you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (the heart icon). Strength rises by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on Map, Activities) and always bring your partner along — while one character trains, the other completes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters, and after the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your Criminal Profile. You can watch the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it helps to turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profile runs from Professional (clean, stealthy work) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent — steer clear of it, since cops get more aggressive. Almost every robbery and fight counts, so this usually pops on its own while you work on everything else; if it is the last one left, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method exists for this trophy yet, and this guide will not guess one. PowerPyx believes it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way — and GTABase lists the exact steps as not confirmed. Check back once a guide confirms it; until then, treat any method you see online as unverified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Walk toward it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — a melee drive-by. Crowded streets in Vice City or along Ocean Beach give you enough targets. GTABase lists the exact steps as not confirmed yet, so this is PowerPyx's method; if it does not pop, keep the kicks inside the 60-second window and stay on the bike.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total, not one delivery, and the robberies for the 100% checklist get you there: a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000, though vaults only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across all kinds of shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive, so they burn through the total fastest. It is a lifetime total, so normal shopping across the whole game counts toward it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages that are for sale, about $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. The app appears after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 purchasable ones. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to raise the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes), each registration costs money, and cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the bill down.
